title: Spoke to men in the Warehouse
content: So I just discovered this thread and it is BLOWING my mind. While I feel so excited to see such similarities in dreams, I am also a little spooked. One dream I had recently was all over the place at first... international travel with my parents via train, we kept going from one place to another but at one point we were rushing to catch the train dragging our luggage and I could see the train at the station But for some reason my dad turned left and back and my brain took this as "ah, right we are going to our hotel now" So as we keep walking towards what looks like a wore down industrial building I start to realize this is a dream. I no longer see my dad but I am still with my mom and at this point I do not want her with me because I realize it's a dream and I don't want anything bad to happen. As I approach a wall, a door starts forming almost like when a game is lagging a little and I tell myself "when I open this door it will be a hotel room and nothing scary " I open it and it is a perfectly normal room w two queen beds to my left. To my left is also a door to a bathroom. I go inside and turn on the light and see myself in the mirror. I look very clear and normal. I even made a face to see if I would move along with it and I did. I had never seen myself so clear in a dream before. I decide I want to explore the map so as I leave the hotel room I realize my mom is no longer there and I am alone and relieved. Immediately outside the hotel room door I am alreadh outside and to my close right appears to be what I assume is a restaurant. The reason I think that is because I see men with black pants and red shirts dressed nicely. They look like fancy restaurant servers. They are all going down and some I think have trays, towards stairs that seem to go to a sort of basement. But again wr are still outside so picture outside stairs that then go Inside to the left as u head down. I decide to follow them thinking it's a restaurant down there. And the outside all still looks like a run down factory. Lots of metal and concrete. As I follow them we enter this huge room. As I look up and to my right I realize we are in an underground HUGE warehouse and as look around in awe trying to figure out what is stored there I see behind me that they are ALL staring at me. These men don't look scary, they look more curious as to what I am doing there. And they're all quiet. I nervously ask them where am I? And this is where it gets weird. As one guy is telling me what sounds like an address I begin to fade away and start to wake up!!! As I try my best to retain what was said to me all I seemed to remember him saying was "stay away from open development " I know this because I wrote it down as soon as I woke but it makes no sense!!! Anyway this dream has really stuck with me and it was my first and only time seeing the warehouse.
